title: ln[A] against time is a straight line for first order
caption: Taking logs of [A] = [A]₀e^(−kt) gives ln[A] = ln[A]₀ − kt: a straight line whose gradient is −k. Here k = 0.116 s⁻¹ (half-life 6 s).
alt: ln[A] against time: a straight line falling from 0 with gradient −0.116.
description: Straight, so the reaction is first order.
